title: Koji Falafel with Mediterranean Sauce
description: A twist on traditional falafel with a boost of umami from koji, served with a creamy mediterranean sauce.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup koji powder
ingredients.notes: available at Asian markets or online

instructions: Soak chickpeas in water overnight. Drain and rinse.
In a food processor, combine chickpeas, koji powder, oregano, garlic, shoyu, and olive oil. Process until coarsely ground.
Using your hands, shape mixture into patties.
Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
While falafel bakes, warm mediterranean sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
Assemble falafel in a pita with warmed sauce and additional toppings, if desired.
Note: For a crisper exterior, pan-fry for 3-4 minutes per side after baking.
